name: Christ the Redeemer, Corcovado

geometryEvidence.note: The reference photo, taken at the platform railing. Not checked on site.

photoSpotReason: Demo stand-in (Agent 6, 15 Nov 2026): at the railing of the summit platform at the foot of the statue, looking south-east over Botafogo to Sugarloaf (the human asked for the view from the railing).

referencePhoto.author: Jazzmaster1997
referencePhoto.crop: Commons 4:3 photo (via a 2560 px copy), 150 px trimmed from the top and the rest from the bottom to 16:9, scaled to 1600x900.
referencePhoto.notes: At the railing of the Corcovado summit platform: a crowd of visitors at the parapet in the foreground, Botafogo bay, Urca and Sugarloaf beyond, the Atlantic and the Niteroi hills on the horizon.
